# Zeenat Collection

> Zeenat Collection is Pakistan's fashion brand for ladies, gents, kids, crochet, jewellery, shoes, makeup, bags, dupattas, fashion sunglasses, caps and umbrellas. Based in Karachi, delivering across Pakistan with cash on delivery. Tagline: "Pehniya Zeenat har mauqay per".

## Key facts
- Prices in PKR: kids items from Rs 980, ladies suits from Rs 4,900, bridal up to Rs 18,500
- Delivery: Karachi Rs 200 (1-2 days), other cities Rs 350 (3-5 days), free over Rs 5,000
- Payment: Cash on Delivery
- Returns: 7-day exchange/return
- Ordering: via WhatsApp
